top_signals.title: Saudi Export Halt Contributes to $3 Oil Jump
top_signals.summary: Oil prices rose nearly $3 on Tuesday after a report said oil loadings at Saudi Arabia's Red Sea port of Yanbu have been suspended, and Libya halted operations at three oil fields, heightening concerns that disruptions to key oil supply routes…

top_signals.title: Brookfield Agrees Recapitalization of Center Parcs at $6 Billion Valuation
top_signals.summary: Brookfield is nearing a recapitalization of Center Parcs in a deal valuing the British holiday park operator at about $6 billion, people familiar with the matter said.

top_signals.title: Oman Rescues 23 from Attacked Oil Tanker, Two Missing
top_signals.summary: Oman's Maritime Security Centre said on Tuesday that the Panama-flagged oil tanker 'EL GAIA' was being towed to an Omani port after a fire broke out in its engine room following an attack.The tanker was about 103 nautical miles northeast of Musandam when it was attacked, the centre said.
